As part of those records, the name, delivery address, and phone number attached to your past orders will remain on file and will not be removed or anonymized.

hero.headline: Become a Tawasi Plus Supplier
hero.subtitle: We're looking for reliable suppliers of nuts, dried fruits, and specialty foods to expand our sourcing network across the UAE and the wider Gulf region.

categories.sectionSubtitle: We welcome suppliers across all of these core categories

requirements.sectionSubtitle: Please make sure you meet the following before applying

requirements.card2Subtitle: Ability to fulfill regular orders in bulk quantities on a consistent schedule
requirements.card3Subtitle: Willingness to provide product samples for inspection and quality evaluation
requirements.card4Subtitle: A valid trade license authorizing your export or supply activity

faq.q1: What documents do I need to apply?
faq.a1: It's best to attach a product brochure or price list, along with any quality certifications you hold.
faq.q2: How long does the review take?
faq.a2: Our team reviews applications within 3 to 5 business days, and we'll reach out shortly after.
faq.a3: Certifications aren't required to apply, but they significantly improve your chances of approval.
faq.q4: Can I apply without samples ready?
faq.a4: Yes, you can apply first — we'll request samples later in the review process if needed.
